issue_context.title: `scheduler_perf` should be able to collect the data for the metric of `framework_extension_point_duration_seconds`
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
run `scheduler_perf` got the below error message, 

```
E1102 09:47:39.025228   29824 util.go:180] metric "scheduler_scheduling_algorithm_predicate_evaluation_seconds" not found
E1102 09:47:39.030145   29824 util.go:180] metric "scheduler_scheduling_algorithm_priority_evaluation_seconds" not found
```

We should provide the metric data for different extension points from the metric of "scheduler_framework_extension_point_duration_seconds"

**Why is this needed**:
Those metrics have been removed by this commit - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/94884
Those metrics are deprecated cause it is suggested to use `Histogram` - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/86391, but simply remove those metrics definitely is not a nice way to address the issue.

/sig scheduling
